digest.component_or_area: M2M outbound reconciliation path (outbound_differ, applier, run_differs)
propositions: The outbound_differ create-path membership test is case-sensitive while the applier guard normalizes to uppercase, causing disagreement when bridge_project differs only in case from mapping keys
The applier guard store-loading wiring (read_projects via apply()) is not exercised end-to-end in tests; only the pure helper is unit-tested
The run_differs outbound seam does not have a test proving that malformed projects.json propagates ValueError and fails closed
The create-path membership check must be made case-insensitive and stamp the canonical mapping key to align with applier normalization
Test coverage must be added for the store-loading guard wiring path through apply() with seeded projects.json and for the run_differs seam's fail-closed ValueError propagation
